releases.name: v0.0.7 – opencode v2 support
releases.body:
## What's new

**opencode v2 support** — one package, both generations, per the official migration guide:

- **v2** (`@opencode/plugin` >= 2.0.0): default export exposes `setup()`, registering the dedicated `title` session hook (`ctx.session.hook("title", ...)`). Detection is structural — the hook only fires for title-generation requests. The system payload (`Array<SystemPart>`) is filtered back to a single pure `PROMPT_TITLE` part; safe no-op if the marker is missing.
- **v1** (`@opencode-ai/plugin` >= 1.18.29): same default export exposes `server()` returning the `experimental.chat.system.transform` hook (content-based detection, unchanged behavior). Older v1 releases (< 1.18.29) only support function-style default exports — pin `0.0.x` there (0.0.6 and earlier keep the pure function export).
- `@opencode/plugin` is a type-only dependency (`Plugin.define` is an identity function) — zero runtime SDK deps beyond gpt-tokenizer.
- v2 server plugins have no TUI toast API, so `notify` logs savings there; toasts remain on v1.
- Docs: dual-generation config examples (`plugins` + object form on v2, `plugin` + tuple on v1), compatibility matrix, and an honest "do you still need this plugin?" section.
- Removed an accidentally committed `package-lock.json` (bun.lock is authoritative).

**Install** (v2 config):

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": [
    "@lifangjin/opencode-session-title-plugin@latest"
  ]
}
```

## Changes

- **Skip toast when no tokens saved** -- suppress toast when `savedTokens <= 0` (no other plugin injected into the title system prompt) instead of showing "system prompt stripped", reducing noise on clean title calls.

## Changes

- **Remove dead `messages.transform` hook** -- confirmed from opencode binary that it only fires in `SessionPrompt.run` and `SessionCompaction.process`, never in `LLM.run`/`ensureTitle`
- **Fix TITLE_MARKER false positives** -- use full sentence `"You are a title generator. You output ONLY a thread title. Nothing else."` instead of short marker that matched orchestrator comments
- **Instant toast** -- replaced 30s polling with immediate toast on token calculation
- **Remove obsolete options** -- `filterMessages`, `notifyTimeout` no longer exist
- **Code cleanup** -- extractPureTitle as pure module-level function, lazy-load fs/path, dump file cleanup (max 10)
- **Debug logging** -- writes to `~/.local/share/opencode/log/session-title-filter.log`
- **Updated READMEs** -- both EN and zh-CN reflect actual behavior

## fix: remove dead messages.transform, add debug logging

### Changes

- **Removed `messages.transform` hook**: opencode only fires `messages.transform` in `SessionPrompt.run` and `SessionCompaction.process`, NOT in `LLM.run`/`ensureTitle`. The hook was dead code that never activated for title calls.
- **Reverted to direct toast call**: `monitorTitleAndNotify` is called directly from `system.transform` (no 5s fallback delay).
- **Added detailed debug logging**: when `debug: true`, dumps every system entry (length + head/tail preview), `originalTokens`, `filteredTokens`, `savedTokens`, and `modelID`.
- **Kept `toastedSessions` dedup**: prevents duplicate toasts from LLM retries.

### Debug

Enable `debug: true` in plugin options to see the token calculation breakdown in opencode logs.

## fix: combine system+message token savings and dedup toasts

### Bug Fixes

- **Token savings always 3018 across projects**: `savedTokens` was only counting `system.transform` savings (constant content). Project-specific content (AGENTS.md, magic-context memory, skill listings) is injected as system/developer role messages via `messages.transform`, which was filtered but not counted. Now `system.transform` stashes savings by sessionID, and `messages.transform` computes message savings and combines for the toast total.
- **Toast showing two different numbers**: LLM retries (`retries:2`) caused `system.transform` to fire multiple times, each starting a `monitorTitleAndNotify`. Added `toastedSessions` Set to dedup toasts per session (60s window).

### Improvements

- Fallback timer (5s) ensures toast still fires when `messages.transform` doesn't run
- Direct toast call when `filterMessages=false` (no unnecessary 5s delay)
- Enhanced debug logging: system/message/total savings breakdown
